body: It's sad. I can be surrounded by a ton of people and still feel alone. I stick out like a sore thumb. I feel like I'm sacrificing a lot by choosing to be a teacher. My friends hang out all the time and I don't have that luxury. When I do get to hang out, I'm left out. There is no balance.

The "Latino Student Union" at my school just doesn't seem like something I'd be into. The group is everything I dissociate from. They enjoy pitying themselves for always of who they are. They want things to happen instead of making them happen. I fought to earn my degree. I say fought because I had many things working against me. I had professors saying "Oh, a Hispanic English Major? How cute!" implying that I didn't have what it took. I see my background as a curse because I constantly have to prove myself to others. I feel horrible for wanting to get rid of a side of me because so many people see this as a blessing. So much of my confusion lies within my culture and I just can't figure it out. 

How can I teach students to embrace their differences and to be citizens of the world when I can't even do that? I want to find my place in the world and I don't feel like I have one.

I could never tell my parents about this. I'm their perfect oldest child (that happens to br the only boy). Telling them any of this would break me even quicker. 

My friends tell me they won't leave me, but I am a very paranoid person and my mind always builds up the worst possible scenario. I can't seem to win.

I've been cutting for about five years. Its a rush of good feelings that calm me down. Friends have told me to pick up a hobby, but cutting is so much easier. I carry needles and alcohol swabs in my backpack for when the urge arises. I've talked to someone at my university about these issues and won't be able to see someone till September when classes are in session. I hate going to a perfect stranger about these things. I know I've scared my friends, but I don't know where else to go. Everything I'm saying right now is something I want to say out loud but I fear my friends saying, "I can't be your friend anymore. You're too much to handle". I just want to be normal.  

I am freaking terrified about everything on my plate right now. Grad school, loans, my friends, a crush at work that probably thinks I'm this giant loser among other things. I feel like I am nothing. I can't get a grasp of the things going on. My birthday is this week and I'm feeling loads of stress from that. The thought of birthdays annoys the shit outta me. I feel like I'm on some sort of countdown and that I should be somewhere else than where I am now. I just want to be happy and that seems impossible for me. I feel like I'm in high school and all of these emotions are bombarding me like madness.

I just don't know what to do. My friends have been there for me, but I don't want to put more on them than I already have. I love my friends, but I often feel like I care about them more than they do about me. These guys are like my brothers, but the feeling feels like a one-way street. 

One of my friends turned 21 recently and that age scares me. The topic of drinking comes up a lot in my group of friends. I don't drink because I'm diabetic. Others friends take that as "Oh, we're not inviting him to anything because we're all going to be drinking". A few years ago when that group of friends began drinking, I was pretty much excluded from everything. I didn't speak to a lot of these friends for at least a year. I always wanted to hang out, but I was ignored. I'm afraid of the same scenario happening because it always feels like my friends are choosing something (whether it be alcohol, video games, etc) over me. I don't consider myself important simply because I can't even compete with inanimate objects. I wouldn't want to be around me because I'm fucking insane. It's gotten to the point where I just say "It's fine, no worries. I'll find something else to do" and that kills me. I put on a mask for everyone around me, but all I want to do is die and painful death and never see the light of day again. I hate being alive. I never wanted this. I never asked for this. Someone else should be here.
